svg.text: Same-u zero-slope exception exclusion
Field-level ordered-guard composition
Result
Three lemmas compiled and passed separate axiom readback: equal_slope_classification, cross_scales and
source_zero_slope_excluded. The native same_u_mixed_zero_slope_delta exception is excluded at field-expression
scope from original validity and the preceding guards.
Original premises
Arbitrary field; two weighted degree-two inputs satisfying their normalized Mumford divisibility conditions;
four nonzero representation weights; literal crossed q and r equalities; earlier inverse guard false; earlier
equal-ordinate guard false. No smoothness or characteristic restriction is needed.
Derivation
The reviewed factor_identity says (v1-v2)(v1+v2) equals C((s1-s2)(s1+s2))*u. Equal slopes make the right side
zero, so the polynomial integral-domain property gives v1=v2 or v1=-v2. Coefficients give the exact
equal/inverse alternatives. Nonzero cross-weight scales transport literal guards into normalized coordinates
and back. If literal sourceK were zero, one of the preceding guards would have held, a contradiction.
Exact source scope
Retained projective_law_gate.rs lines903-933: crossQ/R/S/T retain native multiplication association, including
z^3 and z^5. sourceK is the previously bound literal subtraction. This closes an ordered-guard obligation, not
a new payload formula. PROOF_AUDIT.md already describes the degree argument; the added result is explicit Lean
composition with the crossed source guards.
Controls and failures
A full original-validity application over Q uses f=X^5, u=X^2, v1=X, v2=2X. Equal and inverse controls retain
zero slope; an F2 case uses the same classification without an odd-characteristic premise. A failed-validity
counterexample has matching slopes but neither earlier guard. Initial main tactic/rewrite failure and four
control failures (heartbeat, missing polynomial evaluation API, and coefficient simplification) are retained.
Final control uses coefficient zero instead of importing extra evaluation modules.
Limits and review status
Independent source review pending. The proof relies on reviewed imported factor identity and weighted
normalization definitions; standard axiom readback lists only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. No
UInt64 equality reflection, compiler/counter execution, divisor class-sum or complete degree2+2 dispatcher
result is claimed. No scientific trial was run and cost ratio is null.
